intro: Arkansas Legislative Audit examines every county and publishes what it finds. This page quotes what the auditors reported about Saline County, from its latest report — no verdict added in either direction. What the auditors said is the record; what to make of it is yours.
regulatory_basis_note: Read this before reading any Arkansas audit: county and city reports carry a technical 'adverse opinion' on GAAP grounds because Arkansas law has them keep books on a simpler 'regulatory basis.' That phrase appears in every such audit in the state and signals the accounting format — not wrongdoing. A report is 'clean' or not in its findings, deficiencies, and noncompliance sections, which is what this page quotes.

verdicts.quote: The results of our tests disclosed no instances of noncompliance or other matters that are required to be reported under Government Auditing Standards.
verdicts.detail: On internal control, the auditors wrote: “During our audit we did not identify any deficiencies in internal control that we consider to be material weaknesses.”

limits: From the 2024 report, dated March 17, 2026. Read by machine from the report’s text; the quotes are the auditors’ words. Older reports, and the separate federal (single) audits, aren’t on this page yet.
Arkansas alternates between full audits and limited “financial and compliance” reviews; each line says which this is.

cities.name: Alexander
cities.quote: During our evaluation, noncompliance with state law and accepted accounting practices was noted in the office of the Treasurer. Treasurer Accounting procedures for municipalities are set forth in Ark. Code Ann. §§ 14-59-101 – 14-59-119.

cities.name: Benton
cities.quote: Our review of expenditures totaling $18,874, from January 1, 2025 through June 8, 2026, revealed the following withdrawals: • $14,527 in bank withdrawals and debit transactions, of which $645 was not supported with adequate documentation. • $1,936 in PayPal withdrawals for which adequate supporting documentation was not retained. The validity of the withdrawals without adequate supporting documentation could not be determined.
